DEFAULT_TEAM_DESCRIPTION: 一套开箱即用的 AI 团队：CEO 小笨统管全局，文案小文 / 代码小码 / 数据小数 / 设计小美 / 移动端小移各司其职。装上即可分别私聊，员工请示先由 CEO 把关。每人自带头像、职责边界与系统提示词。
EN_TEAM_DESCRIPTION: A ready-to-use AI team: Ben coordinates the company as CEO, with Wendy for copywriting, Cody for software, Dana for data, Mia for design and Ivy for mobile design. Chat with each teammate individually; the CEO reviews decisions before escalation. Each teammate includes an avatar, clear responsibilities and a dedicated system prompt.

teamToolEnglish.dm_teammate: Send a direct message to a teammate and wait for the reply.
teamToolEnglish.assign_task: Delegate a task asynchronously; review the returned result before reporting completion.
teamToolEnglish.create_employee: Create a teammate with a clear role and responsibilities. Do not edit team files directly.
teamToolEnglish.update_employee: Update only the specified teammate fields. Preserve unspecified fields.
teamToolEnglish.delete_employee: Permanently delete a teammate only with confirm=true.
teamToolEnglish.manage_department: Create, update, list or delete departments. Head and members accept teammate references; member lists replace the previous list.
teamToolEnglish.manage_group: Create, update, list or delete groups. Member lists replace the previous list; coordinator is a teammate reference.
teamToolEnglish.create_schedule: Create a scheduled task for a teammate using the existing trigger and SOP or document fields.
teamToolEnglish.list_schedules: List scheduled tasks, optionally filtering by teammate reference.
teamToolEnglish.delete_schedule: Delete a scheduled task by its stable task ID.
